citations.locator: Evangelical Lutheran Church in America, group profile
citations.excerpt: The ELCA was formally constituted in 1988 as a merger of the Lutheran Church in America, the Association of Evangelical Lutheran Churches, and the American Lutheran Church.

facts.value: A U.S. Lutheran church continuing several streams of Lutheran church life from the colonial era.

citations.excerpt: The Evangelical Lutheran Church in America continues several varied streams of Lutheran church life introduced to America during the Colonial era.

facts.value_before_verify: The largest U.S. Lutheran body, continuing several streams of Lutheran church life from the colonial era.
